title: A Topological Signature of Learning under Noisy Labels
abstract: arXiv:2610.23491v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How does noisy supervision change the representations learned by a neural network? Training accuracy measures agreement with training labels but provides little information about representation geometry. We use persistent homology to track loop structure across distance thresholds in neural activations. Experiments span image classification, text classification, and modular arithmetic. On a fixed CIFAR-10/ResNet-18 training probe, equally sized clean-label and corrupted-label subsets show no detectable persistence difference at epoch 10, whereas corrupted-label subsets have higher persistence at epoch 50. The contrast survives uniform-scale controls, even though predictions match the assigned noisy labels for only 7-11% of corrupted probe examples at that checkpoint. translated_title: 噪声标签下学习的拓扑特征
translated_abstract: 噪声监督如何改变神经网络学习到的表示？训练准确率衡量的是模型与训练标签的一致性，但几乎无法提供关于表示几何结构的信息。我们使用持续同调来追踪神经激活中跨越不同距离阈值的环状结构。实验涵盖图像分类、文本分类和模运算。在固定的 CIFAR-10/ResNet-18 训练探针上，等规模的干净标签子集与损坏标签子集在第 10 个训练轮次时没有可检测到的持续性差异，而在第 50 个训练轮次时，损坏标签子集表现出更高的持续性。即使在该检查点处，损坏探针样本中仅有 7-11% 的预测与所分配的噪声标签相符，这种对比在均匀尺度控制下依然成立。归一化在 CIFAR-10/ResNet-18 上保持了干净与噪声训练轨迹之间的交叉现象，而 CIFAR-100/ResNet-18 在任何（设置下均未出现交叉）（注：原摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文利用持续同调追踪神经激活中的环状结构，发现噪声标签训练的模型在训练中后期比干净标签模型表现出更高的拓扑持续性，即使其预测与噪声标签几乎不一致，从而为噪声监督下的学习过程提供了一种基于表示几何的拓扑特征。
en_tdlr: Using persistent homology to track loop structure in neural activations, this paper shows that corrupted-label training exhibits higher topological persistence late in training than clean-label training, providing a geometric topological signature of learning under noisy supervision.
